_comment: Pin table for third-party wheels this site must host itself, with the sha256
each is verified against. scripts/fetch_vendored_wheels.py is the recipe.
TWO DESTINATIONS, and the difference matters:
vendor/piplite-wheels  -> handed to PipliteAddon.piplite_urls, indexed into
dist/pypi/all.json, resolved by piplite at import time. gitignored via /vendor/.
overlay/assets/wheels  -> picked up by build_manifest.py, sha-verified by D2,
and installed by the bootstrap. gitignored (R6/R8: zero tracked .whl repo-wide).
WHY A PIN FILE AND NOT COMMITTED WHEELS: R6/R8 (check_wheel_coherence.py
--check-untracked) require ZERO tracked .whl repo-wide, and the ADR retired the
hand-committed pylibftdi binary with 'the hand-committed binary with no recipe is
retired, not relocated'. Both destinations are gitignored, so a wheel with no
recipe exists only on the machine that happened to place it -- which is exactly
how websockets went missing from every clean checkout until 2026-08-20.
TO ADD ONE: append an entry with its dest, add it to required[] if the kernel
cannot boot without it, rebuild, and re-run the offline gate.
TO UPDATE A VERSION: change version + sha256 together. The fetcher verifies the
download against BOTH this sha and PyPI's own published digest, and refuses on
any mismatch rather than publishing an unverified file.

wheels.name: comm
wheels.why: ipykernel dependency; in neither pyodide-lock.json nor the piplite index

wheels.name: websockets
wheels.why: PyLabRobot's Visualizer raises in __init__ when HAS_WEBSOCKETS is False; not bundled by Pyodide
